proposed_widenings.name: WeaponFilter.any_of
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger needs a disjunctive filter over existing weapon scopes rather than a single category/property test.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon"

proposed_widenings.name: DiceExpr ability modifier addend
proposed_widenings.justification: Incoming damage reduction needs dice plus a specific ability modifier, which current DiceAmount shapes cannot express.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier"

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.free_hand
proposed_widenings.justification: The reaction is gated on having an available hand, which is a real mechanical precondition and not just flavor.

proposed_widenings.name: catch_triggering_projectile
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can convert a fully negated hit into possession/control of the triggering ammunition or weapon; the current atom inventory has no object-catching effect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon"

notes: The top-level kind and reaction-family shape exist, but the unit cannot be authored honestly without both surface variants and a new object-catching effect atom. No Dhall/JSON content was written.
